Publication statement: Hubei : Hubei guan shu ju, Qing Tongzhi 3 nian [1864]
Shows Hunan and Hubei provinces, including boundary areas with their neighbouring provinces, such as Jiangxi, Henan, Anhui, Shanxi, Sichuan, Guangdong, Guangxi, Guizhou.

Wood block print. Shows Hunan and Hubei provinces, including boundary areas with their neighbouring provinces, such as Jiangxi, Henan, Anhui, Shanxi, Sichuan, Guangdong, Guangxi, Guizhou. Relief shown pictorially. Scale ca. 1:2,000,000. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. AACR2
